ir12_question.topic: Evidence that Iran has sought to avoid direct war with the US: negotiations, calibrated retaliation, stated positions, analysts

claims.text: IPS (Porter, 2007): a May 2003 Iranian proposal, drafted by Ambassador Sadeq Kharrazi with Swiss ambassador Tim Guldimann and faxed to the State Department with Guldimann's 4 May 2003 cover memo, suggested Iran would consider compromises on its nuclear programme, Hezbollah and Hamas, and 'acceptance of the two-states-approach'; Kharrazi reportedly said Khamenei, Khatami and FM Kharrazi agreed '85%-90%'; State Department officials argued Guldimann acted on his own; Rice testified she did not see it; Leverett said it reached the administration

Rubin (National Review) calls the grand-bargain claim false: Guldimann 'often freelanced' and gave different accounts; Armitage reportedly concluded it was 'perhaps more the product of Guldimann'; Rubin says Zarif denied Iranian origin in an email to Parsi

Iraqi PM Abdul-Mahdi's spokesman: 'Shortly after midnight on Wednesday [8 Jan 2020] we received a verbal message' that Iran's response had started or was about to start and would hit only places with US forces; Iraqi military: 22 missiles, 17 at Ain al-Asad and 5 at Erbil; no Iraqi casualties
Zarif, 8 Jan 2020: Iran 'took & concluded proportionate measures in self-defense under Article 51'; 'We do not seek escalation or war, but will defend ourselves against any aggression'
Pentagon, 21 Feb 2020: 110 US service members diagnosed with mild traumatic brain injury from the 8 Jan Ain al-Asad attack; Trump had initially said 'no Americans were harmed'
AP, 23 Jun 2025: Trump: 'I want to thank Iran for giving us early notice, which made it possible for no lives to be lost, and nobody to be injured'; 14 missiles, 13 knocked down, one let go

Khamenei, 14 May 2019, meeting officials in Tehran: 'There will be no war'; 'Neither us, nor them are after a war'; called negotiation with the US a mistake as 'the Americans will not stand by their promises'
First 2025 round: 12 April 2025, Muscat, indirect, Omani FM Albusaidi relaying messages; Araghchi and Witkoff spoke for several minutes; Iran called it 'constructive'
Oman MFA, 19 April 2025: Rome round; next phase; aim of a deal keeping Iran free of nuclear weapons and sanctions
Fifth round 23 May 2025 in Rome: Albusaidi 'some but not conclusive progress'; on 12 June 2025 Oman announced a sixth round in Muscat on Sunday 15 June
AFP: Iran and the US began talks on 6 February 2026 in Muscat; Switzerland said Oman would host the next round in Geneva the following week

Euronews, 26–27 Feb 2026 Geneva round: mediators said 'significant progress'; Araghchi: 'very good progress'; next round 'perhaps less than a week'; US demanded halt to enrichment, missile curbs, end to support for armed groups; Iran would discuss only nuclear issues; Trump gave 15 days; two US carriers in the region
Ali Vaez (ICG), 23 June 2025: Iran 'opted for a symbolic response to a US attack because they don't want further US involvement'

Vaez (NPR, Feb 2026): Iranian leaders concluded only inflicting casualties would deter US and Israeli strikes; regime 'cornered and could act in a reckless way'; Iran sees conflict as less dangerous than surrender to US terms

New America (2020): Barzegar describes forward defence as 'preempting the penetration of symmetric and asymmetric threats inside Iran's borders'; Iran's strategy 'remains cautious'; Clawson calls Iran the 'fireman and the arsonist'; regional rivals see it as ideological expansion

ir12_against.topic: Evidence against: Iranian direct and allied attacks on Americans, hostage-taking, plots on US soil, 2019 attacks, stated hostility

claims.text: Pentagon spokesman Cmdr Sean Robertson (2019): 'at least 603 U.S. personnel deaths in Iraq were the result of Iran-backed militants' in Operation Iraqi Freedom; State: 17% of US personnel deaths 2003–2011; causes incl. EFPs 'allegedly manufactured and supplied by Iran'; up from ~500 earlier; Pentagon did not release the underlying report
Embassy seized 4 Nov 1979; 52 Americans held 444 days
52 released 20 January 1981, minutes after Reagan's inauguration; Khomeini assumed control of the hostages and rejected appeals for release

18 Sept 2023: five Americans (incl. Siamak Namazi, held since 2015; Emad Sharqi; Morad Tahbaz) freed in exchange for clemency for five Iranians and access to $6bn of frozen funds moved to Qatar; US: humanitarian use only; Raisi: the money 'belongs to the people'

Arbabsiar pleaded guilty 17 Oct 2012 to murder-for-hire and terrorism conspiracy in a plot with Iran-based Qods Force members to kill the Saudi ambassador to the US by bombing a restaurant; $1.5m fee, ~$100,000 down payment to an FBI undercover account; told agents senior Qods Force officials recruited, funded and directed him; sentenced to 25 years; Qods Force member Gholam Shakuri charged, at large
10 Aug 2022: DOJ charged IRGC member Shahram Poursafi with offering $300,000 for the murder of John Bolton, likely in retaliation for Soleimani's killing; no action taken against Bolton

8 Nov 2024: DOJ charged Farhad Shakeri, said to be in Iran, alleging the IRGC tasked him on 7 Oct 2024 to plan Trump's killing; two New York men charged over a plot against a dissident journalist (apparently Masih Alinejad); Iran's foreign ministry called the accusations 'totally unfounded'; Garland: few actors pose 'as grave a threat'

13 June 2019: Front Altair and Kokuka Courageous attacked in Gulf of Oman; Pompeo: 'Iran is responsible'; CENTCOM video said to show an IRGC boat removing an unexploded limpet mine; Kokuka's owners said it was hit by shells; Iran denied; Bolton attributed May 2019 damage to four ships off the UAE to Iranian mines, Iran denied

14 Sept 2019 attack on Aramco's Abqaiq and Khurais shut more than 5% of global oil supply; Houthis claimed it; US, European states and Saudi Arabia blamed Iran; Iran denied; UN sanctions panel concluded 'the Houthi forces did not launch the attacks'
Khamenei, 8 Feb 2019 (his website): 'Death to America' means 'death to America's rulers … we have nothing against the American people'

claims.text: IPS: the 2003 proposal was drafted by Iran's ambassador in Paris, Sadeq Kharrazi, in consultation with Guldimann; per Kharrazi's account the leaders agreed '85%-90%', the president and foreign minister raised no objection, while Khamenei had 'some reservations as for some points'

UN panel did not name Iran and was not tasked with attribution; Guterres said the UN was 'unable to independently corroborate' that the missiles and drones were of Iranian origin; Iran denied involvement
US count of the 8 Jan 2020 attack: 15 missiles at two bases, 10 at Al Asad; 109 TBI as of 10 Feb 2020 (raised to 110 on 21 Feb per RFE/RL)
